claims.claim: Under misleading task premises, verifier-written tests inherit the generator's blind spot, so 64-sample test-time selection can choose a hidden-test-wrong candidate although a correct one exists in the pool.
claims.stance_target: LLM-written test verification is not independent of the generator
claims.scope_conditions: three benchmarks, five code models, 64-sample selection
claims.quoted_support: The selector may choose a hidden-test-wrong candidate even when a hidden-test-correct program exists in the pool.

claims.claim: A gold-free predictor from verifier-visible features reaches 0.846 AUROC for predicting recoverable mis-selection (13 features, LR); contamination features alone give 0.539.
claims.stance_target: confidence-like risk signal from verifier-visible features
claims.quoted_support: a lightweight gold-free predictor using verifier-visible features reaches 0.846 AUROC.

claims.claim: Decoupled, premise-agnostic robustness auditors recover substantial oracle headroom whereas coupled scaling gives limited recovery.
claims.stance_target: independent evidence is needed for verification utility
claims.scope_conditions: Qwen-7B / HumanEval+ main cell, Section on mitigation, Table 3
claims.quoted_support: coupled scaling provides limited recovery, whereas premise-agnostic robustness auditors recover substantial oracle headroom.

claims.claim: The paper flags that calibration, threshold stability and transfer remain unstudied.
claims.quoted_support: larger-scale validation is needed to study calibration, threshold stability, and how pre

breadth.confidence_families: Verifier score from LLM-generated tests and score-distribution/signature features used as gold-free predictor (Section 4.4, Table 2). No verbal or hidden-state confidence (searched: verbal, probe, logit).
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B/14B/32B-Instruct, GPT-4o-mini (Section 3 model list); Qwen2.5-Coder 0.5B-32B scale sweep on MBPP (Appendix Table S4-area).
breadth.base_vs_instruct: not present as a pair comparison (all Instruct models); searched: base vs instruct.
breadth.reasoning_models: not present (searched: reasoning model, thinking mode, o1, R1); reasoning not enabled; code instruct models only.
breadth.elicitation_formats: Sampled candidates (64) with verifier-written tests; matched prompt conditions: baseline, irrelevant-control, false-premise (Section 3 Prompt Conditions). No verbal confidence.
breadth.label_source: Hidden-test execution correctness (gold) versus verifier-visible tests written by an LLM (Section 4).
breadth.label_independence: Verifier and generator are coupled by a shared false premise; paper's central claim is that independence fails (Abstract); transfer evaluated across held-out models and datasets (Limitations).
breadth.contamination_split: LiveCodeBench used for 'temporally newer programming problems' (Section 3); 'contamination' in Table 2 refers to verifier-test contamination, not training-data contamination.
breadth.calibration_metrics: AUROC for trap-risk prediction (Table 2); no ECE/Brier; Limitations states calibration not studied.
breadth.granularity: Per-task selection outcome (selected candidate vs hidden tests); no per-test confidence.
breadth.causal_intervention: Prompt-level intervention inserting a false premise vs irrelevant control (Section 3 Prompt Conditions); decoupled-evidence mitigation comparison (Section 5, Table 3). Not a model-internal intervention.
